named-perils.title: Named Perils (Section I-A)
named-perils.plain: Pays only for the dangers listed in the policy: fire, explosion, lightning, landslide, forest fire, impact damage, missile testing, riot and strike, bursting of water tanks, sprinkler leakage, and theft within 7 days of one of these. Anything not on the list is not covered.
ref: because of any Insured Event stated in the policy schedule

perils-list.title: The listed dangers
perils-list.plain: Column A of this table lists each danger that is covered; Column B lists what is still not paid for that danger.
ref: Fire, including due to its own fermentation

stfi.title: Storm and flood (STFI) add-on
stfi.plain: Adds storm, cyclone, typhoon, tempest, hurricane, tornado, tsunami, flood and inundation to Named Perils.
ref: Storm, Cyclone, Typhoon, Tempest, Hurricane, Tornado, Tsunami, Flood

earthquake.title: Earthquake add-on
earthquake.plain: Adds damage caused by earthquake, including landslide or rockslide resulting from it, to Named Perils. Floods caused by an earthquake are not part of it.
ref: property Insured by this policy occasioned by earthquake

all-risk.title: All Risk (Section I-B)
all-risk.plain: Pays for any sudden, accidental physical loss or damage to your property, except what the policy specifically excludes. It covers more situations than Named Perils.

reinstatement.title: Reinstatement value
reinstatement.plain: Insures for what it would cost to rebuild or replace the property with a similar new one, without cutting anything for wear and tear.
ref: can be reinstated or replaced by a similar property, without deducting depreciation

saleable.title: Saleable value
saleable.plain: Insures the building for what it could be sold for today.

loss-limit.title: Loss limit
loss-limit.plain: Insures only up to the amount that could realistically be lost in one single incident, instead of the full value.
ref: appropriate enough to cover the property that is exposed to

stock-basis.title: How stock is valued
stock-basis.plain: Raw material at its landed cost at your premises, stock in process at its input cost, finished stock at its manufacturing cost (or contract price if sold but not delivered).

floater.title: Floater cover
floater.plain: One total amount covers your stock wherever it is among several locations, instead of a fixed amount per location. You must keep records showing what is where.
ref: available for any one, more, or all locations

declaration.title: Declaration policy
declaration.plain: For stock that goes up and down: you pay a provisional premium, declare the stock value regularly, and the premium is adjusted at the end of the year.
ref: We agree to cover Your Stock on receipt of provisional premium

jewellery.title: Jewellery and valuables under Burglary
jewellery.plain: Gold, silver, jewellery, precious stones, watches, money and similar valuables are not covered under Burglary unless they are specifically insured.
ref: Gold, silver or articles made of precious metals

claims.title: How to make a claim
claims.plain: Tell HDFC ERGO immediately, report theft or riot to the police, keep evidence, and submit the claim form within 30 days of noticing the loss.

cancellation.title: Cancelling the policy
cancellation.plain: You can cancel at any time in writing; the refund depends on how long the policy has run.

nominee.title: Nominee
nominee.plain: The person who receives the claim money if something happens to you. The proposal form asks for their name, relation and date of birth.

declaration-proposer.title: Your declaration
declaration-proposer.plain: You confirm that everything in the proposal is true. Wrong or hidden information can make the policy void.
ref: I/We hereby declare that the information given is

addons.name: Terrorism and sabotage
addons.plain: Covers damage from terrorism or sabotage, which the policy otherwise excludes.

addons.name: Loss minimisation
addons.plain: Pays reasonable costs of protecting or moving property to stop a loss getting worse.
ref: reasonable expenses incurred to safe guard the property

addons.name: Extra expenses
addons.plain: A fixed amount for costs of keeping the business running after a claim, such as temporary space or shifting staff.

addons.name: Involuntary betterment
addons.plain: If an identical replacement isn't available, a similar one that does the same job is accepted without a deduction for being better.

addons.name: Rent for alternative premises
addons.plain: Pays the extra rent if your premises become unusable after an insured loss and you move temporarily.
ref: Additional Expenses of Rent for alternative premises

addons.name: Contract works
addons.plain: Covers buildings or works being built or extended at your premises during the policy.

addons.name: Escalation
addons.plain: Increases the sum insured a little every day by an agreed yearly percentage, to keep up with rising values.
ref: increased each day by an amount representing

addons.name: Brand and label
addons.plain: For damaged branded finished goods taken by the insurer, lets you remove your brand or label first.

addons.name: Omission to insure additions
addons.plain: Automatically covers new buildings, machinery or contents you add during the year, up to a limit.
ref: OMISSION TO INSURE ADDITIONS OR EXTENSIONS

addons.name: Temporary removal to exhibition
addons.plain: Covers stock or contents taken temporarily to an exhibition you take part in or host.
ref: temporarily removed to any exhibition site

addons.name: Loss of business income (benefit)
addons.plain: Pays a fixed amount if you cannot run your business because of a government order or an act of God. Not available if Section VII is chosen.

addons.name: Claim preparation cost
addons.plain: Pays fees of accountants, engineers or other professionals needed to prepare an accepted claim.

addons.name: Temporary repair
addons.plain: Lets you start repairs immediately after a loss so the business can keep running.

addons.name: Accidental damage (Named Perils only)
addons.plain: Adds accidental external damage to Named Perils cover.
ref: destroyed or damaged by Accidental External Damage

addons.name: Leakage and overflowing (Named Perils only)
addons.plain: Covers stock lost through leakage or overflow from a storage tank or vessel.
ref: leakage and/or overflowing from any storage tank

sections.name: Property Damage
sections.plain: Fire and allied perils damage to your building, furniture, fittings, machinery, stock and other business contents.
sections.applies: Every policy. This section is compulsory.
ref: because of any Insured Event stated in the policy schedule

sections.name: Burglary and House Breaking
sections.plain: Theft of your property after a forced, violent entry into your premises, or a hold-up.
sections.applies: You keep stock, goods or equipment at your premises that could be stolen.
questions: CCTV or burglar alarm at all premises?
Entries and exits secured with iron grills and locks?
Stock and sales books maintained for each location?

If yes, for how long and at what time?
Cover several locations on floater basis?

multi: Temporary removal of stocks to exhibition

questions: Gold, silver, jewellery or precious stones to be specifically insured?

sections.name: Breakdown of Electrical and Mechanical Appliance
sections.plain: Sudden, unforeseen breakdown of your installed machines and appliances.
sections.applies: You use installed machinery or appliances such as motors, generators, compressors or air-conditioning plant.
questions: Any breakdown claim in the last 3 years?
Are regular inspections of the machinery done?

sections.name: Electronic Equipment Insurance
sections.plain: Physical loss or damage to computers and other electronic equipment at your premises.
sections.applies: You have computers, billing machines, servers, CCTV systems or similar electronics at your premises.
ref: in the manner and to the extent hereinafter provided
questions: Replacement value of the electronic equipment (₹)

sections.name: Portable Electronic Equipment
sections.plain: Laptops, tablets, routers and similar portable devices, at work or while travelling in India.
sections.applies: You or your staff carry laptops, tablets or similar devices outside the premises.
questions: Any equipment claim in the last 3 years?

sections.name: Boiler and Pressure Plant
sections.plain: Damage (other than by fire) to boilers and pressure plant, and your legal liability from them.
sections.applies: You operate boilers or pressure vessels.
ref: Damage (other than by fire) to the Boilers
questions: If water tube type, evaporative capacity per hour
Are all items in good condition? Any defects?
Which items are inspected, by whom and how often?
Last inspection date and approved working pressure
Maximum load on safety valve and working pressure

If yes, amount claimed / final damages (₹)
Is the boiler under regular supervision while working?

sections.name: Business Interruption (other than Machinery Loss of Profit)
sections.plain: Loss of profit when fire or allied perils damage your property and stop the business.
sections.applies: Your business would lose income if a fire stopped it for weeks or months.
ref: This section covers consequential loss following Destruction or damage

multi: Premises where a contract is carried out

sections.name: Business Interruption (Machinery Loss of Profit)
sections.plain: Loss of profit when a breakdown of insured machinery or boiler stops the business.
sections.applies: A machine or boiler breakdown would stop your business.
ref: interrupted or interfered with in consequence of an Accident
questions: Cover loss of profit from machinery breakdown?
Cover loss of profit from boiler explosion?

sections.name: Plate Glass and Sanitary Fittings
sections.plain: Accidental breakage of fixed glass and sanitary fittings in your premises.
sections.applies: Your premises has glass shopfronts, display counters, glass partitions or washrooms.
ref: accidental breakage to Fixed Glass and Sanitary Fittings
questions: Location and glass details (size, framework, tinted/embossed)
Value of the glass and fittings (₹)
Add damage to frame and framework (up to ₹5,000)?

sections.name: Neon Sign / Glow Sign / Hoarding
sections.plain: Loss or damage to your neon signs, glow signs and hoardings.
sections.applies: You have a signboard, glow sign or hoarding.

sections.name: Money
sections.plain: Loss of business cash in your premises, safe or on the way to and from the bank.
sections.applies: You keep cash at your premises or carry cash to or from the bank.
ref: loss of Money belonging to the business or profession
questions: Cash out of safe during business hours (₹)

Single carrying limit, your premises to bank (₹)
Single carrying limit, any other place (₹)

Are the keys removed from the premises after hours?
Is the premises guarded when closed? By whom?
Any past loss of money? Give details

sections.name: Baggage
sections.plain: Loss of or damage to your baggage due to accident or mishap while travelling.
sections.applies: You travel for business with baggage.
ref: loss of or damage to Baggage due to accident or personal mishap
questions: How often do you travel for business?

sections.name: Marine Transit
sections.plain: Your goods while being transported within India, for export, or capital items brought to your premises.
sections.applies: You send or receive goods by road, rail, sea or air.
questions: Add strikes, riots and civil commotion (SRCC)?
Any special agreement with carriers that limits liability?

sections.name: Cyber Risk
sections.plain: Data restoration costs and business loss after a hacking or other security breach.
sections.applies: Your business uses computers, billing software, online systems or customer data.
ref: data Restoration expenses and business interruption losses
questions: Antivirus, firewall and monthly offline backups in place?

sections.name: Public Liability
sections.plain: Your legal liability if visitors or the public are injured or their property is damaged.
sections.applies: Customers, visitors or the public come to your premises.

If yes, lift licence and AMC in place?
Required to insure under the Public Liability Insurance Act?

sections.name: Event Liability
sections.plain: Your legal liability as an event organiser or participant.
sections.applies: You organise or take part in events.
questions: Maximum duration of any single event

sections.name: Infidelity / Dishonesty of Employees
sections.plain: Direct money loss from fraud or dishonesty by your salaried employees.
sections.applies: Employees handle your cash, stock or accounts.
ref: fraud/ dishonesty committed by any Employee
questions: Employee name or designation to cover
Amount to be guaranteed per person (₹)
Do you take references from previous employers? If not, what practice?
Maximum money held by any employee (₹) and for how long
Maximum stock held by any employee (₹) and for how long
Do you collect government IDs before hiring?
How often are your books balanced?
Losses from employee dishonesty in the last 5 years

sections.name: Workmen's Compensation
sections.plain: Compensation you must legally pay if an employee is injured or dies because of their work.
sections.applies: You have employees.
ref: arising out of and in the course of his employment
questions: Insurance required (Table A or B of the prospectus)
Total wages paid in the past 12 months (₹)
Does this include all persons in your service?
Specific job training given to employees?
Standard safety equipment provided to all?

sections.name: Agri Pump Set
sections.plain: Loss or damage to agricultural pump sets and their pipelines.
sections.applies: You use agricultural pump sets.
ref: Agricultural Pump Set (whether electrical or diesel)

sections.name: Agricultural Equipment
sections.plain: Loss or damage to agricultural equipment you own or look after.
sections.applies: You own or keep agricultural equipment.
ref: owned or in the custody of the insured due to

sections.plain: Loss of or damage to bicycles belonging to the business.
sections.applies: Your business owns bicycles, for example for deliveries.
ref: loss of or damage to a Pedal Cycle
